digest.component_or_area: backend-neutrality sweep and J7 adapter boundary
propositions: inbound_fields.py must remain at the package root because moving it to adapters/jira/ would violate the J7 bidirectional adapter seal while adapters/jira_datacenter/ must share the same mapper as Cloud.
Moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira_family/ breaks the mirror-image rule because root-core importers (inbound_differ.py and peer_state.py) are forbidden to consume that layer.

The backend-neutrality sweep exemption for inbound_fields.py should document the permanent architectural reason (J7 sibling-adapter seal and shared DC/Cloud mapper) rather than treat it as temporary relocation debt.
The module's by-path lazy-load of adapters/jira/adf.py cannot be safely routed through jira_family/ without laundering the AST contract gate.
Commit a3148ad85b rewrites test_backend_neutrality.py exemption wording to explain the durable J7 constraint while leaving production code, imports, and sweep membership unchanged.
